effects.title: Basic Attack
effects.description: Yangyang melakukan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan Aero DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack
effects.description: Yangyang mengonsumsi STA untuk menerjang ke depan, memberikan Aero DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack: Zephyr Song
effects.description: Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Heavy Attack atau Dodge Counter untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Zephyr Song, memberikan Aero DMG.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack
effects.description: Yangyang mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dari udara, memberikan Aero DMG.

effects.title: Dodge Counter
effects.description: Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge yang berhasil untuk menusuk ke depan, memberikan Aero DMG.
Yangyang mengayunkan pedangnya untuk menciptakan pusaran angin yang menarik musuh di sekitar ke arah pusat, memberikan Aero DMG.
Yangyang memanggil sebuah Cyclone dahsyat yang menarik musuh di sekitar, memberikan Aero DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack: Stormy Strike
effects.description: Saat Yangyang memiliki 3 Melodies, ia dapat melancarkan Stormy Strike setelah Heavy Attack atau Dodge Counter, memberikan Aero DMG.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack: Feather Release
effects.description: Saat Yangyang memiliki 3 Melodies, lancarkan Basic Attack di udara untuk mengonsumsi semua Melodies dan melakukan serangan berturut-turut sembari menukik dari udara, memberikan Aero DMG. Saat Yangyang mendarat, ia menyarungkan pedangnya dengan sebuah serangan, memberikan Aero DMG, yang dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

effects.title: Melody
effects.description:
Yangyang dapat menampung hingga 3 Melodies.
Yangyang mendapatkan 1 Melody untuk setiap Basic Attack 4 yang mengenai target.
Yangyang mendapatkan 1 Melody untuk setiap Heavy Attack Zephyr Song yang mengenai target.
Yangyang mendapatkan 1 Melody untuk setiap Resonance Skill Zephyr Domain yang mengenai target.
Yangyang mendapatkan 1 Melody saat melancarkan Intro Skill Cerulean Song.
Yangyang memulihkan 30 STA setelah ia melancarkan Mid-air Attack Feather Release.
Aero DMG Bonus Yangyang meningkat sebesar 8% selama 8 detik setelah melancarkan Intro Skill Cerulean Song.
Yangyang sends the target into the air, dealing Aero DMG.
Memulihkan 4 Resonance Energy per detik selama 5 detik untuk Resonator yang masuk.
Intro Skill Cerulean Song meningkatkan Aero DMG Bonus Yangyang sebesar tambahan 15% selama 8 detik.

sequences.name: Nesting Twigs, In Beaks They Harrow

effects.description: Heavy Attack memulihkan tambahan 10 Resonance Energy untuk Yangyang saat mengenai target, yang dapat dipicu 1 kali setiap 20 detik.
Resonance Skill DMG Bonus meningkat sebesar 40%. Efek penarik Wind Field terhadap target di sekitar diperkuat, dan jangkauan tarikannya diperluas sebesar 33%.

sequences.name: Close Your Eyes And Listen In

effects.description: Damage dari Mid-air Attack Feather Release meningkat sebesar 95%.
Damage dari Resonance Liberation Wind Spirals meningkat sebesar 85%.

sequences.name: A Tribute To Life'S Sweet Hymn

effects.description: Setelah melancarkan Mid-air Attack Feather Release, ATK dari semua anggota tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 20 detik.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1011-G]

The exact time and cause of Resonator Yangyang's Awakening remain unclear. Resonator Yangyang reports heightened sensitivity to her surroundings since her childhood.

The Tacet Mark of Resonator Yangyang is located in the center of her forehead. Post-Awakening observations found no notable physical change. As frequency fluctuations resurge, limited feather-like transformation have been observed on the ends of her hair.

Resonator Yangyang synchronizes with the surrounding air by detecting information in air streams and creating an energy field using converging airflow.

The Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Resonator Yangyang displays over 20% resemblance to that of airflow and smaller bird species. While a strong Syntony reaction is present, the pattern also shares over 5% similarity with multiple other existing samples, indicating potential multiple or contaminating causes of Awakening.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a stable rise. Occasional fluctuations within the normal range have been detected. Therefore, Yangyang is identified as a Natural Resonator.

TalentCertification.Title: Overclock Diagnostic Report
TalentCertification.Content:
The waveform graph for Resonator Yangyang displays stable elliptical fluctuations in the Time Domain with no abnormal patterns. Upon examination, all results fall within normal parameters.

In terms of Resonant Criticality, Resonator Yangyang ranks at a relatively low level with high stability. Examination results appear to fall within normal parameters with no risk of Overclocking.

Resonator Yangyang has a documented history of Overclocking.
Maximum Overclocking rating: Negligible.

During the event, Resonator Yangyang experienced emotional overflow and temporary loss of Forte control. Fortunately, there were no casualties or hazards reported, though she suffered several comatose episodes due to the overstimulation. Further examination revealed that Yangyang's heightened perception was causing harm to her body through her Forte. The aftereffects have since stabilized, but the feather-like transformation on the ends of her hair remains irreversible. Yangyang's sensory overload has been managed and her emotional state is stable, with a positive prognosis. Routine examinations are recommended for monitoring purposes.
